confirm_delete_memory: Are you sure you want to delete this memory?
memory_generation_prompt_help: This prompt is used when analyzing conversations to extract important memories. The conversation text will be automatically appended to the end of this prompt.
google_drive_not_connected: Google Drive is not connected. Click 'Connect Drive' to enable automatic document syncing.
disconnect_google_drive_warning: Are you sure you want to disconnect Google Drive? This will stop automatic document syncing.
remove_synced_files: Remove synced files from knowledge base
remove_synced_files_explanation: If checked, all Google Drive files previously synced to the knowledge base will be permanently removed.
folder_selection_explanation: Select which Google Drive folders you want to monitor for automatic document syncing. Only files from selected folders will be included in your knowledge base.
at_least_one_folder_required: You must select at least one folder to enable syncing.
maximum_10_folders_allowed: You can select a maximum of 10 folders.
no_folders_selected_sync_warning: Please select at least one folder to monitor using the "Manage Folders" button before syncing.
google_drive_sync_disabled_warning: If you save without selecting any folders, Google Drive sync will be disabled. Select at least one folder to enable automatic syncing.
email_not_connected: Email is not connected. Click 'Connect Email' to enable automatic email syncing.
subject: Subject
imap_password_help: Use your email password or app-specific password for enhanced security.
disconnect_email_warning: Are you sure you want to disconnect email? This will stop automatic email syncing.
remove_synced_emails: Remove synced emails from knowledge base
remove_synced_emails_explanation: If checked, all emails previously synced to the knowledge base will be permanently removed.
no_onedrive_folders_selected: No OneDrive folders selected. Please select at least one folder to monitor before syncing.
onedrive_not_connected: OneDrive is not connected. Click 'Connect OneDrive' to enable automatic document syncing.
disconnect_onedrive_warning: Are you sure you want to disconnect OneDrive? This will stop automatic document syncing.
no_files_uploaded: No files uploaded. Upload files by clicking the 'Upload Files' button.
email_integration_warning: Warning: Email integration makes the inbox content available to all company users. By adding the integration, you accept that all users in the company can access the email content.
lightrag_chunk_token_size_help: Number of tokens per text chunk (default: 800). Smaller chunks = more precise retrieval, larger chunks = more context.
lightrag_chunk_overlap_size_help: Number of overlapping tokens between chunks (default: 100). Higher overlap preserves context across chunks.
lightrag_entity_extract_max_gleaning_hel: Maximum iterations for entity extraction refinement (default: 1). Higher values improve accuracy but increase processing time.
lightrag_query_top_k_help: Number of top results to retrieve per query (default: 60). Higher values provide more context but may include less relevant results.
lightrag_query_max_tokens_help: Maximum tokens for query response (default: 30000). Controls the length of generated answers.
lightrag_max_async_llm_help: Maximum concurrent LLM API calls (default: 4). Higher values speed up processing but increase API load.
lightrag_max_async_embedding_help: Maximum concurrent embedding API calls (default: 16). Higher values speed up document processing.
lightrag_embedding_batch_size_help: Number of texts to embed in one batch (default: 32). Higher values improve throughput.
lightrag_max_parallel_insert_help: Number of documents to process simultaneously (default: 4). Higher values speed up bulk uploads.
no_memories_generated: No memories have been created for this company yet.
external_api_key_help: Use this key with the REST /api/chat endpoint (header X-API-Key). Keep it secret.
confirm_regenerate_api_key: Regenerate API key? This will invalidate the old one.
confirm_revoke_api_key: Revoke this API key? Clients using it will stop working.
